title: Application is hereby made by Eastern Edison Company, under the provisions of M.G.L. c. 164, § 95G1/2 and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 131, for approval of a change in the Company's Oil Conservation Adjustment charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings in the months of June, July and August, 1989. The Oil Conservation Adjustment charge is designed to recover the cost of conversion from oil-fired to coal-fired generation, and its calculation is based on the respective costs of burning coal and burning oil.
